reader_summary.overview: Acquired is live on the scene covering Salesforce's blockbuster $27.7B acquisition of Slack. We dissect the deal itself, Slack's relatively short life as a public company, the impact of Microsoft and Teams. And oh yeah — we have a ton of fun too.
